detail: A test that cannot run is not green. tests/test_fn_e1e2_two_store_owner.py has been dead on dev since at least 2026-09-29 and no gate saw it: (1) its module does not import on dev (it imports free_port from tests.test_native_protected_peering, which stopped defining it at ee0622a74); (2) its own case NativeTwoStoreMiniHandoff.test_two_store_mini_exchange is env-gated (FN_E1E2_HANDOFF + FN_E1E2_R_SOURCE), so even an import fix leaves it skipped in every ordinary run; (3) once run with the env (train C17b stand-in 919a41a17518-e1e2 on hbox, R_SOURCE tests/fixtures/dregg-e1/source.eml) it errors on fixture drift: initialize() lost its port argument (d4c808649 era) and the protected-peering base class has no await_article. Register finding, same root: the daily dev control run (tools/dev_control.py modules) lists only tests/test_native_*.py plus IMAGE_RULES modules, and the known-reds register accepts only tests.test_native_* native subjects, so a native module named otherwise is neither run by control nor recordable as a red. Owed: (a) dev_control's module set and the register's subject rule cover every native module (by what it starts, not its file name), and an env-gated case with no gate that supplies its env is reported NOT RUN by name; (b) the e1e2 case repaired against the current fixture API or retired with the dregg E1/E2 handoff it serves (decide which first). C17b backed its import fix out (lane/b-native-launch-review4 da986e314) rather than land a module whose case errors.

title: e1e2 two-store handoff test dead since 09-29 and invisible to every gate; dev control and the register skip non-test_native native modules
